description: Search upcoming dance events on udansa (parties, workshops, festivals, congresses, balls) - the same results as the event search page. Filter by free text, city, dance style (any language), category, weekday, organizer and price. Recurring events appear once with their next date. Each result has id, title, style, type, city, venue, start/end, price_from (null when the organizer has not published a price; 'free' only when it really costs nothing), how tickets are sold ('udansa', 'external', 'at_the_door'), a short summary and the event page URL. Use get_event_details for tickets and programme.

category.description: Exact event category from filter_options.category of a search result, e.g. 'party', 'workshop', 'festival'.

city.description: City as listed on udansa, usually the local name ('München', 'Wien'). English names like 'Munich' are tried as well. Values: filter_options.city or get_search_filter_options.

language.description: Two-letter language code for texts, style names and page links (de, en, fr, es, it, ...). Default de.

level.description: Exact level value from filter_options.level of a search result.

provider.description: Exact dance school or organizer name from filter_options.provider of a search result; use query for partial names.

query.description: Free text, partial words allowed, e.g. 'Salsa beginners'.

style.description: Dance style name in any language, e.g. 'Bachata', 'Wedding dance', 'Hochzeitstanz'. Values: filter_options.style or get_search_filter_options.

name: search_dance_events
title: Search dance events
